$comment: The structured log line of every function of dian-einvoice, PHP and TypeScript: one JSON object per line, with exactly these fields. The single source of truth of the schema: the formatter of the backend (App\Support\Observability\JsonLogFormatter), the logger of the TypeScript functions (infra/functions/shared/log.mts), the metric filters and saved queries of the CDK app (infra/cdk/lib/observability.ts) and make cloud-check are held to it by their tests; docs/observability.md explains it. A field is present on every line, null when it does not apply; error and detail only when there is one. Internal identifiers only: never an email, an identification number, a key, a token, a password or the body of a document.

correlation.description: A ULID in lower case, born at the first entry into the system (a request to the API or a scheduled run), answered to the client in the header and carried by every event of the outbox, SNS and SQS message, job, call to the DIAN, webhook delivery and email of that journey. A value the client sends is kept only when it matches the pattern.

fields.name: time
fields.description: The moment of the line, UTC, ISO 8601 with milliseconds: 2026-11-20T15:04:05.123Z.

fields.name: level
fields.description: The severity, the levels of PSR-3 in lower case.

fields.name: message
fields.description: What happened, in a sentence, with secrets and personal data masked.

fields.name: function
fields.description: The function that wrote the line: its name without dian-einvoice-<stage>-; outside Lambda the process (api, console, worker).

fields.name: stage
fields.description: The stage of the platform: local, prod; outside the functions the environment of the application.

fields.name: correlation_id
fields.description: The id of the journey the line belongs to (correlation, above).

fields.name: request_id
fields.description: The request or invocation that wrote the line: the X-Request-Id of a request to the API, the id AWS gives the invocation of any other function.

fields.name: company_id
fields.description: The company the work acts on: an internal id, never its name or NIT.

fields.name: actor
fields.description: Who acts: user:<id> or api-key:<id> in a request, system in jobs, scheduled runs and operations.

fields.name: document_id
fields.description: The electronic document the work is about: an internal id, never its number, CUFE or content.

fields.name: event
fields.description: What kind of line it is, one of events below; null for a line of the framework or a library.

fields.name: duration_ms
fields.description: How long the work took, in milliseconds.

fields.name: error
fields.description: On an error: its class, its message (masked like the message) and a trace cut to its first frames, as file:line function, without arguments.

fields.name: detail
fields.description: A few more values, each one of detail below; anything else is dropped.

method.description: The HTTP method of a request.

route.description: The route of a request as declared, its parameters unfilled: api/v1/invoices/{document}/issue.

status.description: An HTTP status: of the answer to a request, of the DIAN or of a webhook endpoint.

job.description: The short name of the class of a queued job: TransmitDocument.

queue.description: The queue a job came from: chain, webhooks (the functions) or the Redis queue (locally).

attempt.description: The attempt of a job or a delivery, from 1.

operation.description: The operation of the web service of the DIAN: SendBillSync, GetStatus.

result.description: How a call ended in detail: responded, found, not_found, timeout, connection_error, server_error, client_error, invalid_response.

status_code.description: The StatusCode of an answer of the DIAN: 00 validated, 66 not processed, 99 with errors.

rule.description: A rule of the DIAN that rejected or notified a document: FAD06.

event_type.description: The type of an outbox or webhook event: document.issued.

subscription_id.description: The internal id of a webhook subscription.

count.description: How many: events published, items restarted.

path.description: Which path of the outbox published: fast (the writer, after its commit) or relay.

lag_seconds.description: The age of the oldest outbox event still unpublished after a run of the relay, 0 when there is none.

sweeper.description: The short name of a sweeper: StalledChainSweeper.

task.description: A task of the Laravel scheduler.

command.description: The name of an artisan command, without its arguments.

exit_code.description: The exit code of a command.

secret.description: The name of a secret read (never its value): dian-einvoice/local/database/application.

credential.description: What a refused authentication brought: password, api_key.

reason.description: Why something was refused or skipped, in a few words.

alarm.description: The name of a CloudWatch alarm.

state.description: The new state of an alarm: ALARM, OK, INSUFFICIENT_DATA.

runbook.description: The runbook of an alarm: docs/runbooks/<name>.md.

events.http.request: A request the API answered: its route, method, status and time (function api).
events.auth.refused: A sign-in with a wrong password or a request with an API key that is not valid, revoked or expired.
events.document.issued: An invoice, credit note or debit note issued: numbered, with its first outbox event.
events.outbox.published: Outbox events a writer published itself right after its commit (the fast path).
events.outbox.relayed: One outbox event the relay published because its writer did not: should be almost never (the safety net).
events.outbox.relay_run: One run of the relay: how many it published and the lag of the outbox after it.
events.outbox.swept: A sweeper restarted stalled items: chains, deliveries, webhooks.
events.chain.resumed: A step of the chain or of the delivery that gave up came back from the dead-letter queue (an operator moved its message back) and started again, as Retry now does.
events.queue.job: A queued job ran: its class, queue, attempt, time and outcome.
events.queue.dead_letter: A job gave up for good: a copy of its message went to the dead-letter queue of its queue, where an operator moves it back once the cause is fixed (docs/runbooks/dead-letters.md).
events.dian.call: A call to the web service of the DIAN: operation, HTTP status, time, result.
events.dian.response: The DIAN accepted or rejected a document.
events.dian.rule: One rule of the DIAN that rejected a document or notified something about it.
events.delivery.email: The email of a document to the customer, sent or failed.
events.webhook.delivery: One delivery attempt of a webhook to the endpoint of a subscription.
events.secret.reread: The database refused the credentials of an execution environment and its secret was read again (a rotation).
events.console.command: An artisan command the functions relay, scheduler or console ran.
events.scheduler.task: A task of the Laravel scheduler ran.
events.runtime.output: A line a process printed outside the logger (PHP itself, a subprocess), kept as its message.
events.edge.refused: The origin verifier refused a request that did not come through the edge.
events.edge.secret: The origin verifier read the secret of the edge, or could not.
events.alarm.notification: The notifier turned an alarm into a message and sent it, skipped it or could not.
